page.overview:
What is Earth (Invincible)?

Earth is the main setting of Invincible and the home planet of the human race, which coexists alongside other intelligent species.

Earth is the densest planet in the solar system, the largest terrestrial body in its system, and a marine world where water traditionally covered roughly 71% of its mountain-and-valley landscape.

Earth’s sociocultural system is a hyper-volatile, multi-layered civilization where a mundane, capitalist human society coexists with existential sci-fi and supernatural anomalies, all stabilizing under the utilitarian hegemony of the Global Defense Agency. Led by Cecil Stedman, this shadow state operates with extreme moral ambiguity, manipulating international politics and weaponizing reformed villains to maintain a fragile status quo. Within the public sphere, superheroes are highly institutionalized as both critical national security infrastructure and heavily commercialized, media-managed celebrities, fostering a civilian population defined by a state of profound cognitive dissonance. Regular people aggressively pursue normal lives, going to school, working retail, and paying bills, while treating city-leveling battles like severe weather events, where survival simply means returning to a normal work week the very next day. For the superhero community, this creates an exhausted, 24/7 bureaucratic grind of hyper-vigilance and psychological trauma.

This surface-dwelling society shares the planet with sovereign, isolationist species, such as the monarchical Atlanteans and subterranean Magmanites, all while looming under the existential threat of the Viltrum Empire. This Darwinistic warrior race infiltrates Earth's culture to assess its defenses, ultimately viewing human existence with contempt, yet its unique emotional depth acts as a psychological trap powerful enough to subvert centuries of rigid imperial conditioning in Viltrumites who stay too long.

Also known as: Earth, Invincible Earth.
